knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}

#load required packages
require(tidyverse) 
require(httr)
require(readxl)
require(here)

#set path to root of project
here("ooi-carbonate-setup")

```

## Access OOI data from Alfresco

```{r}


# Pioneer 14 Sampling Log Version 1-01
log_url <- ('https://alfresco.oceanobservatories.org/alfresco/webdav/OOI/Coastal%20Pioneer%20Array/Cruise%20Data/Pioneer-14_AR44_2020-06-07/Ship%20Data/Water%20Sampling/Pioneer-14_AR44_CTD_Sampling_Log_2020-12-07_Ver_1-01.xlsx')

# Pioneer 14 salinity data Version 1-01
sal_url <- ('https://alfresco.oceanobservatories.org/alfresco/webdav/OOI/Coastal%20Pioneer%20Array/Cruise%20Data/Pioneer-14_AR44_2020-06-07/Ship%20Data/Water%20Sampling/Pioneer-14_AR44_Salinity_Sample_Data_2020-12-07_Ver_1-01.xlsx')


```


```{r}

# Supply credentials for Alfresco
creds <- read_file("authenticate.txt")
#creds <- read_csv("authenticate.csv")

httr::GET(log_url, authenticate(creds, creds), write_disk(logtf <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")))

logtf

httr::GET(sal_url, authenticate(creds, creds), write_disk(saltf <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")))

saltf

```

## Read in Excel file from Alfresco and format cruise ID and column headers

```{r}

log <- read_excel(logtf, 1L) 
sal <- read_excel(saltf, 1L) 

```

# count DICTA and pH bottles

```{r}

n_distinct(log$`DIC/TA Bottle #`, na.rm = TRUE)
n_distinct(log$`Ph Bottle #`, na.rm = TRUE)

```
```{r}

bottles <- log %>%
  rename(Cruise_ID = "Cruise ID") %>%
  rename(PH_bottle = "Ph Bottle #") %>%
  rename(DICTA_bottle = "DIC/TA Bottle #") %>%
  rename(salts_bottle = "Salts Bottle #")

headers <- c("Cruise_ID", "PH_bottle", "DICTA_bottle", "salts_bottle")
bottles <- bottles[, headers]


 # next join salt and bottles

```
